checks.label: Website
checks.pass: You have a website customers can find.
checks.fail: No website was given, so customers searching for you find competitors first.
checks.unreachable: Your website did not load when we tried it, so visitors may see an error too.
checks.fix: Add your website address, or ask us to build a simple page from your brand brain.

checks.label: Instagram profile
checks.fix: Add your Instagram handle so we can include it in your audit and content plan.

checks.label: Google Business Profile
checks.pass: Your Google Business Profile is linked.
checks.fail: No Google Business Profile was given. Local searches and map results lean heavily on it.
checks.fix: Create or claim your free profile on Google, then add its link here.

checks.label: Secure connection
checks.pass: Your site loads securely over HTTPS.
checks.fail: Your site does not load over HTTPS, so browsers warn visitors it is not secure.
checks.fix: Turn on a free SSL certificate with your web host.

checks.label: WhatsApp link
checks.pass: Visitors can message you on WhatsApp in one tap.
checks.fail: There is no WhatsApp link, so visitors have to copy your number and message you themselves.
checks.fix: Add a WhatsApp button that opens a chat with your business number.

checks.label: Tap to call
checks.pass: Your phone number can be tapped to call.
checks.fail: Your phone number cannot be tapped to call on a mobile phone.
checks.fix: Make your phone number a tap to call link.

checks.label: Clear next step
checks.pass: Your site invites visitors to book, enquire or request a quote.
checks.fail: Your site does not clearly invite visitors to book, enquire or request a quote.
checks.fix: Add one obvious button near the top, such as Book a consultation or Request an inspection.

checks.label: Mobile friendly
checks.pass: Your site is set up for mobile screens.
checks.fail: Your site is not set up for mobile screens, so it looks tiny on phones.
checks.fix: Ask your web developer to add a mobile viewport setting and test the site on a phone.

checks.label: Response speed
checks.fail: Your site was slow to respond. Many visitors leave before a slow page loads.
checks.fix: Check your hosting plan and remove heavy plugins or scripts.

checks.label: Page title
checks.pass: Your page title is a good length for search results.
checks.fail: Your page title is missing or a poor length for search results.
checks.fix: Write a title that names your business, what you do and where, in about 50 to 60 characters.

checks.label: Search description
checks.pass: Your page has a search description.
checks.fail: Your page has no useful search description, so Google picks random text to show.
checks.fix: Write a one or two sentence description of what you offer and who for.

checks.label: Enquiry form
checks.pass: Visitors can send an enquiry through a form.
checks.fail: There is no enquiry form on this page.
checks.fix: Add a short form asking for name, phone and what the visitor needs.

checks.label: Business details for search engines
checks.pass: Your site tells search engines your business details in a structured way.
checks.fail: Your site does not give search engines your business details in a structured way.
checks.fix: Add LocalBusiness structured data with your name, address, phone and opening hours.

checks.label: Social links
checks.pass: Your site links to your social profiles.
checks.fail: Your site does not link to any social profiles.
checks.fix: Link your Instagram and Facebook pages from the footer.

checks.label: Map or directions
checks.pass: Visitors can find directions to you.
checks.fail: There is no map or directions link.
checks.fix: Link to your Google Maps listing so visitors can get directions.

checks.label: Reviews on the page
checks.pass: Your page shows reviews or testimonials.
checks.fail: Your page shows no reviews or testimonials, which new customers look for before trusting you.
checks.fix: Show three recent reviews with the customer's first name.

checks.label: Visitor tracking
checks.fail: Your site does not measure visitors, so you cannot tell which ads or posts bring customers.
checks.fix: Add Google Analytics and the Meta pixel. We will connect them in a later step.

checks.label: Share preview image
checks.pass: Your link shows a preview image when shared on WhatsApp and social media.
checks.fail: Your link shows no preview image when shared on WhatsApp and social media.
checks.fix: Set a share image, ideally your logo or a photo of your work.

checks.label: Page size
checks.pass: Your page is a reasonable size for mobile data.
checks.fail: Your page is heavy, which costs visitors mobile data and time.
checks.fix: Compress large images before uploading them.

areas.label: Response
areas.detail: Can they reach you in one tap
